fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully perimeter-fenced (chain-link visible in multiple Street View frames around the dock yard), but no barrier arm, sliding gate, or staffed checkpoint was observed at any imaged drive mouth. The 1973-era campus uses open driveways from the public loop road into the fenced yard. Called false but flagged: some drive mouths are partially obscured by the fence-line buffer in Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth (1-3 vehicle footprint, multi-side windows) observed at any entrance across full Street View perimeter coverage. The only standalone yard structures are a fenced equipment/container compound and dock canopies, not a gatehouse.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because no truck gate was confirmed; if a controlled gate exists at an obscured drive, it would more likely be remote/kiosk given the absence of a booth, but not confirmed.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band estimated from a large grocery DC (~500k+ sqft) with dock banks on the NE (sawtooth/angled), east, and south faces plus a long south dock row; count is approximate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock clusters on different building faces (NE/east angled docks vs. the long south dock bank), consistent with separate ship/receive flows at a grocery DC; inferred.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 25-50 band from trailer rows in the SE/south drop yard plus the eastern overflow trailer lot; many trailers parked bobtail without tractors.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage areas: an SE drop yard adjacent to the building and a large eastern overflow trailer lot (separated by a wooded buffer, connected by internal drive).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main DC plus secondary long buildings/cross-dock structures and a maintenance/shop cluster to the SE, sharing the parcel and parking.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open paved aprons and multiple open drive mouths give ample room to add an express/bypass lane if a controlled gate were installed.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Inferred — the front yard connects to the public loop road via shared open drives; no separate dedicated in/out gates observed.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approximate; open drive mouths roughly two trucks wide, no painted lane control.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park off US-17 (Warrenton Rd) on the Stafford/Fredericksburg fringe with woods buffering the parcel; classified Rural per the small-town-industrial tie-break rule.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: False — sits in an active industrial park with adjacent development and retail, so cellular coverage is likely adequate; low confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property in any imagery.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved interior aprons/yard between the building and the property edge provide deep internal queuing/staging room.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus ~3 secondary structures (SE long buildings/cross-dock + maintenance/shop).
